title: Location Presence Distance Leaderboard
dataSources: Life service health (`lifeos:service`), personal scorecards (`lifeos:score`), breach notifications (`hibp:breach`), location visits (`location:visit`), runbook checklists (`runbook:checklist`), and Home Assistant outage events (`homeassistant:event`).
app: Apple and Google location exports, Have I Been Pwned breach alerts, Todoist-style personal runbooks, and Home Assistant outage events streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=location:visit distance_km=*
| stats sum(distance_km) as total_value, avg(distance_km) as avg_value by city
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks city values by total and average distance across location presence events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `distance_km` values for each location presence event and review total and average distance by city.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total distance.

references.title: Have I Been Pwned API v3

grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which city shows the biggest distance numbers in your location presence data.
